svg.title: The build in order on the cut-down build, after touch table.c: each target checked once, after everything it needs
svg.text: touch table.c, then bin/make: the targets in the search's finishing order

g.title: Everything was built once; then table.c is touched, and is now newer than table.o. Nothing is checked yet.
freq.c and ds.h are files with no rule, and there. freq.o is up to date: nothing it needs was made, and none of it is newer.
util.c is a file with no rule, and there. util.o is up to date: nothing it needs was made, and none of it is newer.
table.c is a file with no rule, and there. table.o: table.c is newer, so table.o is out of date: its recipe runs, touch table.o.
libds.a: table.o was made, so libds.a is out of date: its recipe runs, touch libds.a.
freq: libds.a was made, so freq is out of date: its recipe runs, touch freq.
g.text: out of date: table.o, libds.a, freq

g.title: sort.c is a file with no rule, and there. sort.o is up to date: nothing it needs was made, and none of it is newer.
g.text: out of date: table.o, libds.a, freq

g.title: sort: libds.a was made, so sort is out of date: its recipe runs, touch sort.
g.text: out of date: table.o, libds.a, freq, sort

g.title: all is phony, so it is always out of date, and it has no recipe to run. The build ran 4 recipes: table.o, libds.a, freq and sort.
g.text: out of date: table.o, libds.a, freq, sort, all
